method: Direct view_image review of unedited UE captures; original header pixel audit verifies selection brightness and detects the old defect. Alpha review covers all 14 native journal PNGs.
observations: Exactly the selected header icon is gold; all other icons are neutral gray and visibly dimmer.
The old main glyph returns to gray when any other category is selected.
Only the selected category underline is gold, including hover over another category and repeated refreshes.
Unknown rows and empty detail panes remain blank with their original separators.
Known content keeps its original descriptions; 150% text remains readable without overlap.
